upcoming.title: Foeder For Thought
upcoming.body:
Alongside our good friend Michael Kiser, founder of Good Beer Hunting, we’re excited to welcome you back for another year of celebrating fermentation-forward beer, thoughtful conversation, and the people behind it all.

This year, Foeder For Thought takes on a more intimate format, bringing the entire experience inside Webb’s City Cellar. From 2–7pm, ticketholders will have exclusive access to the Cellar, creating an atmosphere designed for slowing down, exploring what’s in your glass, and spending more time with the brewers and producers behind each pour.

At its core, Foeder For Thought has always been about blurring the boundaries between consumer and producer. This year’s setting brings that idea to life in a new way, encouraging conversation and connection. Guests will have the opportunity to taste through each producer’s offerings at their own pace, connect one-on-one with our featured brewers, and take part in thoughtful discussions led by Michael Kiser.

And come hungry. BeyLoved Pairings returns to curate a food experience alongside LOKO Cuisine, with thoughtful dishes created to complement and enhance the beers from each featured producer. The pairings are an integral part of the Foeder For Thought experience - not just a bite here and there. Our goal is simple: arrive hungry and leave full, with plenty of incredible beer and food to explore along the way.

Ticketholders can expect:

  • 20 world-class fermentation-forward beers from five featured breweries

    • Cellarest Beer Project - Asheville, NC

    • Is/Was Brewing - Chicago, IL

    • Keeping Together - Santa Fe, NM

    • Occam Cider - Hudson Valley, NY

    • The Seed - Atlantic City, NJ

  • Four beers from each guest brewery

  • Unlimited pours of all Foeder For Thought beers and draft in both Tasting Rooms at Green Bench Brewing (GB Main & Webb’s City Cellar) from 2–7pm

  • Exclusive access to Webb’s City Cellar for the duration of the festival

  • Curated food pairings by BeyLoved Pairings, prepared by LOKO Cuisine

  • Commemorative YETI® merchandise

  • Access to Q&A and panel discussions led by Michael Kiser

  • One-on-one time with featured brewers, producers, and fellow industry guests

Foeder For Thought has always been about more than what’s in the glass. It’s about the people, processes, ideas, and conversations behind it. This year’s more intimate format gives us the opportunity to return to the heart of the festival and experience it together in the place that embodies that spirit every day - Webb’s City Cellar.

We couldn’t be more excited to share it with you. As always, thank you for being part of Foeder For Thought.

Sponsored by: Yeti®

This is a 21+ event. Rain or shine. No refunds.

Please drink responsibly.

PURCHASE TICKETS HERE

past.title: Oktoberfest
past.body:
Oktoberfest at Green Bench returns for its 5th year this Saturday, September 19 - 12–5pm!

Every year, we celebrate alongside the opening weekend of Munich Oktoberfest, and this year we’re borrowing a tradition straight from the source: reserved Beer Garden tables!

Expect an afternoon full of:
German-style beers
Offset Sandwich Exchange Oktoberfest menu
First Quality Sausage House
Apple Strudel Band at 1pm
Firkin tappings at 2pm
Stein Hoisting Competition at 4pm

Want the best seat in the house? Reserve one of our very limited tables inside the Oktoberfest tent and enjoy the festivities from your own dedicated spot.

RSVP HERE

Please note: Oktoberfest is free and open to the public, and a table reservation is not required to attend. We’ll have plenty of additional seating and shaded areas throughout the Green Bench campus available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Prost! 🍻

past.title: Greetings From Florida: A Green Bench & Barriehaus Lager Celebration
past.body:
We’re teaming up once again with our friends Barriehaus Beer Co. to bring the ultimate lager celebration to Tampa Bay Beer Week.

☀️ Greetings From Florida ☀️ returns for its 4th year - a vibrant showcase of crisp, refreshing, and beautifully crafted lagers from 30+ world-class breweries, all pouring right here in the Sunshine State. From classic European-inspired styles to modern interpretations, this festival is a love letter to all things lager.

Join us Friday, March 13th from 5-9pm at Green Bench Brewing Co. as we transform Baum Ave. into a tropical lager paradise filled with great beer, great people, live entertainment, and that unmistakable Florida energy. Break out your loudest Hawaiian shirt, bring your lager-loving crew, and settle in for an unforgettable night celebrating one of the world’s most beloved beer styles.

A special thank you to YETI and BEV Wedge, our exclusive draft sponsors, bringing an innovative and exciting new approach to the world of jockey boxes - keeping every pour perfectly cold and fresh.

Here's what you can expect:

  • Over 30 featured breweries

  • Over 75 lager beers on tap

    • 2 beers from each guest brewey

    • A stellar line-up from Green Bench & Barriehaus

  • Commemorative merchandise

  • Florida-inspired live entertainment

  • Fantastic Florida food options for purchase from:

    • Offset Sandwich Exchange

    • Lost Coast Oysters

    • Cipolla Rosa Pizza

Green Bench and Webb’s City Cellar will remain open to the public with beers for purchase by the glass, but…ONLY TICKET HOLDERS will have access to the Greetings From Florida festival beers and guest breweries. Tickets include:

  • Over 30 featured breweries - some never before featured in Florida

  • Over 75 lager beers on tap

  • Unlimited pours (please drink responsibly) from 5-9pm

  • Commemorative glass mug

Tickets

  • $75

  • PURCHASE HERE

  • This is a rain or shine event. Please note that all sales are final and we are unable to offer refunds.

past.title: Taps & Teufels
past.body:
A KRAMPUSLAUF

A TRADITIONAL AUSTRIAN-STYLE PROCESSION TELLING THE FOLKLORE TALE OF KRAMPUS

WHAT IS KRAMPUSNACHT?

Krampusnacht, like Halloween, is a blend of folklore traditions and Christian influences. Krampusnacht is a Central European traditional festival celebrated on the evening of Dec. 5 and closely tied to the Feast of St. Nikolaus which is celebrated on Dec. 6th. The Krampus figure is partner to St. Nicholas who rewards the good children while Krampus is only concerned with punishing the bad children.

WHAT IS KRAMPUS VEREIN PINELLAS COUNTY?

Verein simply means ‘CLUB’ or ‘GROUP’ in German. We are part of the German American Friendship Society (GAFS) of Pinellas Park, FL. We are modeled after the family friendly European festivals mentioned above. Our Krampus do not intend to frighten children! They are meant as reminders of good behavior – Krampus is watching!

Bringing the tradition of Krampus to the holidays in the Tampa Bay area since 2024, we have been invited to various events and present our own weekend which consists of Krampusnacht, Krampus Market and St Nikolaus Festival/Christkindlmarket at the GAFS.

Our Krampus enjoy taking photos with you! The helpers you see with them explain who they are and accept donations from their generous fans!

Take a photo with Krampus and tag us on Facebook! @ Krampus Verein Pinellas

past.title: Oktoberfest
past.body:
Prost, friends - it’s that time again!

Our 4th Annual Oktoberfest is happening Saturday, September 20th from 12–5pm—and as tradition goes, we’re raising our steins the very same day the celebrations kick off in Munich!

No tickets needed, this party is open to the public - just bring your crew and your best Oktoberfest spirit. Guarantee your firkin tappings and secure a stein by pre-ordering HERE! 🍻

Here’s what’s on tap for the day:
🍺 ½ & full liter steins of your favorite beers
🥨 German-inspired eats from @offsetsandwichexchange
🪗 Live traditional tunes from Apple Strudel Band
🎪 A lively beer tent atmosphere
💪 Stein hoisting competition (start practicing now!)

Mark those calendars, dust off the lederhosen & dirndls, and come celebrate the reason for the season with us!
